title: 5-star Iowa women's basketball target Nation Williams to make commitment decision Wednesday
text:
5-star Iowa women's basketball target Nation Williams to make commitment decision Wednesday Schedule Football Basketball Women's Basketball Recruiting Big Ten Sports Newsletter WOMEN'S BASKETBALL 5-star Iowa women's basketball target Nation Williams to make commitment decision Wednesday
 Josh Helmer Hawkeyes Wire Nov. 11, 2026, 4:46 a.m. CT Top Iowa women's basketball target Nation Williams has reached her decision date.
 Williams announced that she will reveal her college commitment at 7 p.m. CT on Wednesday, Nov. 11. A five-star class of 2027 prospect out of Las Vegas' Centennial High School, Williams is choosing from finalists Iowa , Duke , North Carolina , Notre Dame and UCLA .
 Per Rivals , Williams is ranked as a five-star, as the nation's No. 10 player, as the No. 2 power forward and as the top player in Nevada in the 2027 class. ESPN also rates Williams as a five-star recruit and as the No. 11 player nationally. According to 247Sports , Williams is the country's No. 11 player overall, the No. 2 power forward, and the top player in Nevada. Williams is a four-star prospect per 247Sports.
 Williams is the daughter of Natalie Williams, who starred at UCLA from 1990-94. Natalie Williams was an All-American in basketball and volleyball while at UCLA.
 Natalie Williams was then a four-time All-Star during a seven-year WNBA career with the Utah Starzz and Indiana Fever, was on the gold medal winning 2000 U.S. Olympic team, and she served as the Las Vegas Aces general manager. Natalie Williams was inducted into the Women's Basketball Hall of Fame in 2016.
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. It's quite the basketball lineage that Nation Williams is following. But, Nation Williams is carving out her own impressive basketball story, and that next chapter will begin to be written on Wednesday evening.
 Iowa currently has 2027 commitments from guard Jada Seubert out of Wisconsin and center Khalia Hartwell out of South Carolina.
